title: Claude prompt submission review
scope: Message Tool prompt delivery and submit key handling for Claude sessions

evidence.observation: Text reaches Claude's input box but is not submitted.
evidence.risk: The UI reports or implies a sent prompt while Claude remains in its editor, causing silent lost work and duplicate sends.

evidence.observation: Provider input is delivered through the common AgentMux send boundary, while terminal keyboard protocol state is learned from the live PTY.
evidence.risk: A static Enter/CR assumption can write text successfully but miss the provider's active submit sequence.

decision.submission: Use the provider's declared prompt readiness and keyboard protocol state to send the actual submit sequence, then confirm delivery through the existing runtime/terminal observation path.
decision.failure: Keep the draft and expose a retryable inline state when submission is not confirmed.

acceptance: A Claude prompt test proves the text write and submit key are both sent in order.
The send path does not claim success while Claude remains in its input editor.
Readiness or submit failure keeps the user's text available and is visible without blocking a healthy Agent.
